items.t: Risperidone, oral · Initial dose: 2–4 mg at night.
Risperidone, oral, 2 mg daily. (Doctor prescribed.) · Increase to 4 mg daily if there is a poor response after 4 weeks.
Risperidone, oral. 5–12 years (under 50 kg): · Starting dose: 0.01 mg/kg/day.

cautions.t: Lower dose in the elderly and in renal or hepatic impairment

adverse_effects.t: Extrapyramidal effects, hyperprolactinaemia, weight gain, postural hypotension, sedation
